brief:
The Gaza Health Ministry reported Wednesday that Israeli military operations have killed at least 74,564 Palestinians and wounded 175,770 since October 2023, Middle East Eye reported.

The casualty figures underscore the scale of destruction across the territory over the past year of conflict. The Health Ministry's count includes both confirmed deaths and those documented through hospital records and civil defence reports.
dek: Israel’s genocide in Gaza: Death toll rises to 74,564 Israel’s genocide in Gaza has killed at least 74,564 Palestinians and wounded 175,770 since October 2023, the Palestinian Ministry of Health in Gaza said on Wednesday.
title: Gaza death toll reaches 74,564 since October 2023
